description: Guarda is the sgraffito village on a terrace above the Inn. It was its own municipality until it joined Scuol in 2015, and the lane of white Engadin houses, carved windows, and a fountain is still the village itself. It is not the valley town of Scuol along the river. The afternoon is cool and heavily clouded, the lane is free of snow, and there is no rain.
